learning_question: For every buy-tier name in every graduated library market, are the four F9-B binds true, computed from that name's research folder and library screen with the same meanings as the FTSE inventory, and which binds are the gaps?
fcf_basis_definition: Library screens do not store fcf_basis_overlay. The free-cash-flow bind is true only when the same divergence check the live screen records as that boolean can be evaluated. Evaluation needs a numeric screen free_cashflow from the point-in-time screen, and a filing-side free cash flow from sources/financials_annual.json (operating cash flow plus capital expenditure, otherwise the reported Free Cash Flow line), otherwise sources/sec_companyfacts.json latest.free_cashflow, otherwise a resolved sources/fcf_bridge.json with a numeric company-adjusted or policy figure. Each file counts only when it carries a timestamp on or before the as-of date. The evaluated yes/no is stored as fcf_basis_overlay. A missing side leaves the bind false and fcf_basis_overlay null. A true or false overlay is bound either way, matching the FTSE inventory.
